description: Ribalta language support: diagnostics, completion, go to definition, formatting and route map
config.path: Path to the `ribalta` command line tool, installed with `cargo install ribalta-cli`.
config.theme: Project theme applied before each document. Relative paths are resolved from the folder of each file. When empty, a `theme.ribalta` next to the file is used, if there is one.
config.language: Language of the compiler messages. `auto` follows the editor language.
